description: Run only the MCP configuration rules (VGL-MCP-*): unpinned server packages, literal secrets in env/headers/args, cleartext remote endpoints, disabled TLS verification, dangerous mounts, auto-approval and prompt-injection surfaces. Reads .mcp.json, mcp.json, mcp-config.json, claude_desktop_config.json, opencode.json[c], *.mcp.json and YAML variants; with includeUser it also reads known home-directory configs. Deterministic and offline: no configured server is started, no endpoint is contacted and nothing is written. Results are windowed: maxFindings is the page size (default 50, capped at 500) and offset selects the page; the page object states total, hasMore and nextOffset, and a coverage object states what was read. Returns a text summary and the audit result as structuredContent.

includeUser.description: Also read known user-level MCP configs under the home directory.

maxFindings.description: Page size: maximum findings in this window (default 50, capped at 500).

offset.description: Zero-based finding offset for paging. Start with 0, then pass page.nextOffset from the previous result.

path.description: Directory to audit. Defaults to the server's project root; the resolved path must stay inside it.

name: vigil_mcp_audit
title: Audit MCP server configuration
